samples_manifest.description: CSV manifest with run_id,genecsv,hpotxt columns; runs every listed sample in one workflow.

genecsv.description: CSV exported from AI_MARRVEL containing candidate genes.

input_vcf.description: VCF file containing variants for the proband.

aim_store_dir.description: Directory where AI-MARRVEL stores its outputs.

hpostxt.description: Text file listing proband HPO IDs (one per line).

consideringgenes_g.description: Number of top genes to embed into each LLM prompt.

invocationnumber_n.description: Number of prompt iterations / LLM votes.

run_id.description: Namespace for workflow outputs. Ignored when --samples_manifest is used, which takes run_id from the manifest.

publishDirSuffix.description: Optional suffix for the publish directory, e.g. /udn_100 publishes to published/udn_100/<run_id>/. Must start with '/'.
